sections.heading: Identity and current status
sections.body:
- Project ID: `mistral-vibe`
- Canonical name: Mistral Vibe (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-identity`); coding mode Vibe Code (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-identity-vibe-code`); family formerly Le Chat (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-identity-family`)
- Current status: active (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-status`)
- Last source-backed identity check: 2026-08-17
- Vendor: Mistral AI (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-vendor`)
- Canonical URL: repo `https://github.com/mistralai/mistral-vibe` (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-canonical-url`); product `https://mistral.ai/products/vibe/` (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-canonical-url-product`)
- Repository: `https://github.com/mistralai/mistral-vibe` (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-repository-url`)
- Version: 2.24.1 (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-version`); VS Code extension 1.15.102 as of 2026-08-14 (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-version-vscode`)
- Availability: UNIX official; Windows unofficial (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-availability`)

sections.heading: What it is and is not
sections.body:
- What it is: a coding agent across CLI, IDE, and remote web (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-what-it-is`) with surfaces CLI, VS Code extension, Vibe Code Web, and ACP clients (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-what-it-is-surfaces`)
- What it is not: not Vibe Work (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-what-it-is-not-work`). A first-party desktop IDE download is not established (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-what-it-is-not-ide`)

sections.heading: Architecture and agent-loop ownership
sections.body:
- Primary type: `runtime` (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-primary-type`)
- Agent-loop owner: first-party app server owns the loop (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-agent-loop`)
- Architecture: Python Textual CLI with ACP (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-architecture`); standalone `vibe-app-server` binary (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-api-app-server`)

sections.heading: Surfaces and execution location
sections.body:
- Surface ledger rows were not written this pass. First-party surfaces in prose:
  - Interactive CLI `vibe` (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-cli`)
  - Programmatic `vibe --prompt` (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-programmatic`)
  - VS Code extension (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-vscode`)
  - ACP: Zed, JetBrains, community Neovim (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-zed`, `claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-jetbrains`, `claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-neovim`)
  - Vibe Code Web at `https://chat.mistral.ai/code` (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-code-web`, `claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-code-web-url`)
  - CLI-to-web teleport (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-teleport`)
  - GitHub Action (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-github-action`)
  - Slack thread-triggered sessions in rollout (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-slack`); limits page still lists Slack as planned (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-slack-planned`); rollout who/where unknown (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-slack-rollout-scope`)
  - Experimental CLI `/voice` dictation (`claim-mistral-vibe-sf-voice-cli`)
  - Product Voxtral voice input — not the same surface as CLI `/voice` (`claim-mistral-vibe-sf-voice-voxtral`)
- Execution location: same-device local tree for CLI/VS Code/ACP (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-execution-local`); vendor-cloud sandbox for Code Web (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-execution-cloud`). Enterprise customers can deploy Vibe on-premises, in a private cloud, or on Mistral Cloud with full data residency (`claim-mistral-vibe-sf-deploy-enterprise`)

sections.heading: Model/auth/provider strategy
sections.body:
- Model strategy: plan sign-in or compatible key (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-model-strategy`); Code Web fixed to Medium 3.5 (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-model-strategy-web`); Medium 3.5 default from 2026-05-22 (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-model-default`); Devstral at launch (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-model-launch`); Opus 4.7 support in 2.9.0 (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-model-opus-47`)
- Auth strategy: account sign-in or API key (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-auth-strategy`); `~/.vibe/.env` (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-auth-env-file`); OS keyring since 2.17.0 (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-auth-keyring`); custom-domain browser sign-in (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-auth-custom-domain`)
- Provider support: OpenAI-compatible, vLLM, llama.cpp, LM Studio, Ollama (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-provider-offline`); Vertex AI (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-provider-vertex`); Responses adapter (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-provider-openai-responses`)
- BYOK: no `claim-mistral-vibe-sf-*` BYOK row. Pages say “custom API key” / “any compatible API key you provide” but do not say BYOK or “operator-supplied keys” as the lock requires. Do not read `field=byok` as supported. Existing `claim-mistral-vibe-nw-tag-byok` is a prior capability tag, not reminted.
- Subscription reuse: existing tag records Mistral-plan reuse (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-tag-subscription-reuse`). Not a Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini subscription.
- Local models: sourced — offline recommended Devstral Small 2 and Mistral Small 4 (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-local-models`, `claim-mistral-vibe-nw-tag-local-models`)

sections.heading: Context, memory, compaction, and session behavior
sections.body:
- Context behavior: project scan, mentions, AGENTS.md (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-context`); editor context in VS Code (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-context-vscode`)
- Memory: AGENTS.md instruction files (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-memory-agents-md`). Memories is a Chat feature, not Vibe Code (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-memory-chat`)
- Compaction: `/compact` with replaceable prompt (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-compaction`)
- Session behavior: local resume per directory (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-session-local`); shared CLI and VS Code sessions (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-session-shared`); web sessions not resumable after end (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-session-web`)

sections.body:

sections.heading: Orchestration and parallelism
sections.body:
- Orchestration: agent profiles and subagents (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-orchestration`); git worktree isolation (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-orchestration-worktrees`)
- Default-agent rename tension, kept not averaged: README says accept-edits is the default and applies to `-p` (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-agents-default-readme`); docs say a `default` agent asks before tools and `-p` falls back to auto-approve (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-agents-default-docs`); CHANGELOG 2.24.1 says default agent renamed to `ask` (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-agents-default-changelog`)
- Parallelism: plan-dependent concurrent web sessions (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-parallelism-web`); parallel tool execution (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-parallelism-tools`)

sections.heading: Isolation, permissions, security, and data path
sections.body:
- Isolation: per-session web sandbox (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-isolation-web`); single-tenant outbound-only sandbox (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-isolation-sandbox-env`). Local CLI OS/container sandbox is not attested — permissions/trust/worktrees only. Do not flatten local to a sandbox Yes.
- Permissions: layered approval controls (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-permissions`)
- Security: trusted folders (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-security`); documented prompt-injection posture on web (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-security-web`)
- Data path: `~/.vibe` state; telemetry opt-out (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-data-path`); ephemeral web sandbox, GitHub artifacts persist (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-data-path-web`); Slack content not used for training (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-data-path-slack`)

sections.heading: Interface inventory plus remote/mobile/background behavior
sections.body:
Surface ledger rows were not written this pass. Do not treat the prose names below as `surfaces.jsonl` IDs.

- Interface and surfaces in prose: CLI, `-p`, VS Code, ACP, Code Web, teleport, GitHub Action, Slack, CLI `/voice`, product Voxtral voice (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-cli`, `claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-vscode`, `claim-mistral-vibe-nw-surface-code-web`, `claim-mistral-vibe-sf-voice-cli`, `claim-mistral-vibe-sf-voice-voxtral`)
- Remote behavior: teleport prerequisites (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-remote-access`). Docs: one-way CLI → cloud (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-remote-one-way`). Limits: web → CLI planned (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-remote-web-to-cli-planned`). May 28 post frames teleport as bidirectional (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-remote-teleport-may28`). Pricing table and product FAQ say pick the session back up locally (`claim-mistral-vibe-sf-pricing-teleport-bidirectional-copy`). Keep all four; do not average.
- Mobile behavior: first-party iOS and Android apps (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-mobile-app-links`, `claim-mistral-vibe-cmp-mobile`); mobile can launch remote sessions (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-mobile-launch-remote`); apps are for Work and Chat on the go (`claim-mistral-vibe-sf-mobile-work-chat`); local on-device coding unknown (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-mobile-local-unknown`)
- Background behavior: notifications and background shells (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-background-readme`); `/loop` recurring runs (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-background-loop`); remote runs continue unattended (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-background-remote`)

sections.heading: Pricing, license, maintenance, and lock-in
sections.body:
- Pricing: Pro $14.99/mo and Team $24.99/user/mo (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-pricing`); Free limited web quotas 2/day, paid 100/day (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-pricing-web-quotas`); VS Code requires paid plan or Studio key (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-pricing-vscode`, `claim-mistral-vibe-sf-vscode-requires-paid-or-studio`); verified students can get Mistral Pro for $5.99/month (`claim-mistral-vibe-sf-pricing-student`). Free FAQ says terminal Vibe Code is included; the Free card still says limited coding sessions (`claim-mistral-vibe-sf-free-cli-faq`). Do not claim harness Apache $0 as the product price.
- License: Apache-2.0 for the CLI (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-license`). Hosted Vibe is a plan/ToS Service.
- Maintenance: active release cadence (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-maintenance`); daily update checks (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-maintenance-update-checks`)
- Lock-in: open CLI, Mistral-bound remoting (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-lock-in`)

sections.heading: Unique edge, meaningful drawbacks, best fit, and not-for
sections.body:
- Unique edge: shared engine plus CLI-to-cloud hand-off (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-unique`)
- Meaningful drawbacks: Windows unofficial (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-drawback-windows`); no stop controls and no resume after web end (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-drawback-web`); open CLI but Mistral-bound remoting (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-lock-in`)
- Best fit: developers in terminal, IDE, or remote tasks (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-intended-user`)
- Not-for: not for local-dependency work in the cloud sandbox (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-not-for-local-deps`); not Vibe Work (`claim-mistral-vibe-nw-what-it-is-not-work`)
